utilities.title: 📊 Website Analyzer
utilities.description: Analyze websites, gather network/HTML data, create custom bookmarklets
utilities.href: javascript:(function(){let deCoM=((b64)=>{stream = new DecompressionStream('gzip'); w=stream.writable.getWriter();w.write(Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));w.close();return new Response(stream.readable).arrayBuffer().then(d=>new TextDecoder().decode(d));});deCoM('').then(v=>eval(v));})();
